title: GET /api/v1/users/:username/heartbeats/spans, 200
description: StatsController#user_spans (stats_controller.rb lines 115-126) returns Heartbeat.to_span (heartbeatable.rb lines 86-134) over every category, in one order across the selected projects, with the 120 s timeout. A span ends at a heartbeat whose next gap is over 120 s (line 109). Its tail is min(gap, 120) (line 113), and that gap is over 120, so every span but the last gets exactly 120 s added. The last span ends at the last heartbeat and gets no tail. Only a span whose duration is 0 is dropped (line 121), and only the last span can have that: a lone final heartbeat, or in theory a final span whose heartbeats lie less than half a second apart. A lone heartbeat followed by a gap over 120 s is kept as a span of 120 s.

start_time.description: Epoch seconds of the span's first heartbeat.

end_time.description: The span's last heartbeat's time plus its tail, in epoch seconds: 120 s later for every span but the last, which ends at its last heartbeat.

duration.description: The span's last heartbeat minus its first, rounded to whole seconds (line 110), plus the 120 s tail, which is the Integer timeout itself (lines 87 and 113), or with no tail for the last span. So it is always a whole number, at least 120 for every span but the last and at least 1 for the last.
